history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A black and white, high-contrast, dramatic portrait of a young man sitting on a motorcycle at night. He has dark, styled hair and is looking off to the right of the frame with a serious expression. He is wearing a black leather jacket with decorative detailing on the sleeves, a black t-shirt, and black pants with knee pads. The motorcycle is partially visible, with a focus on the handlebars and the man's hands.

The background is dimly lit and features a modern building with illuminated windows in the distance. There are trees with sparse foliage, tall grass, and a paved walkway with cobblestone-like patterns in the foreground. A fire hydrant is visible to the left, and a signpost with text that appears to be "YTC2 053" stands to the right. The overall lighting is moody and atmospheric, with strong shadows cast by the trees and the man. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the textures and forms within the scene. The mood is cool, edgy, and slightly mysterious. The style is reminiscent of urban photography or a cinematic still.
